# Agriturismo La Natura

> Farm restaurant (agriturismo) in Savigliano, Piedmont, Italy. Homestyle countryside cuisine from Alfred and Silvana: garden produce, Italian meat, lunch and dinner bookings.

## Essential facts

- Name: Agriturismo La Natura
- Type: Agriturismo / restaurant
- Address: Strada Santa Scolastica 2, 12038 Savigliano (CN), Italy
- Coordinates: 44.6008322, 7.6209577
- Phone / WhatsApp: +39 329 186 7492
- Cuisine: Piedmontese countryside cooking; garden-to-table; Italian meat only
- Price range: €13–30
- Working lunch: €13 (Mon–Sat), includes antipasto, primo, secondo, dessert, coffee, 1/4 wine, water
- Cover charge / water: not charged
- Hours: Lunch 12:00–15:00 · Dinner 19:30–24:00 · Closed Tuesday evening
- Booking note: from 5 people upward
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/agriturismo_la_natura/
- Website: https://lanaturasavigliano.it/
- Legal name: Società Agricola La Natura Società Semplice
- VAT / tax code: 04159780040
- REA: CN 340357
- PEC: sa.lanatura.ss@confagricoltura.legalmail.it
